## Who it's for
Active men 25–55 with tissue, mobility and gut recovery goals.

## What it is (bible, one line)
Dual-peptide recovery stack focused on connective tissue, inflammation support, gut lining, mobility, and soft-tissue recovery.

## Creative direction (bible)
- Talent: fit, rugged men 30–45 with a masculine, performance-driven look. Strong gym talent, intense training, refined execution.
- Include “Wolverine Stack” and “BPC-157 / TB-500” on every design.
- No animal death. Fighting imagery is fine without blood or gore.

## Hard stops (this product)
- Lines the screening table marks ❌ / Hard NO conflict: never. Everything that is not a Hard NO is wording, and wording is free.
- Wolverine Stack is RECOVERY support. No "heal", "repairs", "regenerate", "injury", "pain", "inflammation", "torn", "cure", "treat", "boost",
  "fast"/"faster" as an outcome, no timing promises, no guarantees. "Supports", never "builds". "Aids Tissue Repair"
  only with Jeremy's OK (⚠), exactly as the bible writes it; the page also says "No direct claims".
- **No needles, syringes, pens, injecting or "needle-free"** in words or pictures. The vial stands or lies on a surface; a hand may hold it.
- One product image: the Rx vial. Copy never states a strength, dose, mL or count; ingredients only together as on the label (BPC-157 + TB-500 (two peptides)).
- People: active men 25–55, rugged, strong, unmistakably masculine (`mens-direction.md`); fighting imagery fine **without blood or gore,
  no animal death**; no before/after, no body comparison, no body-composition words in copy.
- No "Are you/Do you…?" questions, no first person, no named competitors, no "clinically" for the product.
- "Wolverine Stack" big in every ad and "BPC-157 / TB-500" on every design (bible, 2026-11-02; mandatory stack rule 2026-11-03: legible, as supporting copy, a subheadline or an ingredient callout, 4:5 and 9:16). An ad without the peptide list fails QA. Never "by Everlife" on images.
- Proof wording exact; disclaimer verbatim (the footer handles both).

## Offer, CTAs and claims (from the bible, version 1793905953-bc2f; generated, never edit)
- **Offer:** "Save Up to 39%" is the product's highest discount (bible rule 09; source: CTA). It is the default CTA. Always "Save Up to N%", never a fixed discount, never another product's %.
- **Default CTA:** "Save Up to 39%". **All bible CTAs:** "Explore the Wolverine Stack" · "Build Your Recovery Protocol" · "Save Up to 39%" · "Support Whole-Body Recovery" · "Start Your Stack" · "Wolverine Stack for $6.50/day" · "Ships Free From Pharmacy". The gate refuses any other CTA string.
- **Price CTA (approved alternative; the only $ amount allowed):** "Wolverine Stack for $6.50/day".
- **Quick-hit benefits (word for word, the only benefit lines):** 2-in-1 Recovery Support · Reinforces Tendons + Ligaments · Supports Gut Lining Health · Maintains Mobility · Supports Healthy Inflammatory Balance · Aids Tissue Repair · Promotes Joint Comfort · Promotes Muscle Recovery · Promotes Mobility + Flexibility · 2-Peptide Whole-Body Recovery · Supports Joints, Gut + Mobility in One Stack · Supports Connective Tissue Health · Supports Digestive Resilience · Supports Whole-Body Recovery.
- **Product Hard NOs (bible):** No animal death, blood or gore. · No direct claims. · Plus all global Hard NOs on page 3.
- **Retired, never use (left the bible or banned):** Get Started Now.
